# cairn setup codex

Register Cairn as a Codex stdio MCP server

## Help

```text
Register Cairn as a Codex stdio MCP server

Usage: cairn setup codex [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  remove  Remove the Cairn MCP server from Codex config
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --scope <SCOPE>
          Codex config scope: local or project

          Possible values:
          - local:   Register in the user's `~/.codex/config.toml`
          - project: Register in the project's `.codex/config.toml`

          [default: local]

      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>
          Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides CAIRN_VAULT)

      --project-dir <PATH>
          Project directory used for project Codex config and hooks

      --home-dir <PATH>
          Home directory used for local Codex config

      --server-name <NAME>
          Codex MCP server name to configure

          [default: cairn]

      --json
          Emit JSON receipt instead of human-readable output

      --binary <PATH>
          Cairn binary path to register as the MCP command

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## Subcommands

- [`cairn setup codex remove`](setup-codex-remove.md) - Remove the Cairn MCP server from Codex config
